name: K-Lifestyle & Industries Limited
about: K-Lifestyle & Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of textile goods in India. The company was formerly known as Krishna Lifestyle Technologies Limited and changed its name to K-Lifestyle and Industries Limited in October 2010. K-Lifestyle and Industries Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Mumbai, India. K-Lifestyle & Industries Limited is in corporate insolvency resolution process under the provisions of Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
